approvers: Just me; maybe the developer client and the window installer
reason: I do houses and small blocks, our windows are not that many square metres and 100 m² minimum is more than some of my jobs have. We cover scratched glass with cardboard and tape or deal with it at cleaning, and I have never paid anyone for this.
objection: Never seen it used in Malta. I am not putting a coating on a client's glass on my site when nobody here has done it and I would be the first.
instead: Cardboard, tape and cheap film from the hardware store, and make the installer fit windows late and clean at the end.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on a finished local block of similar size, and the window installer I use telling me it works and the glass came out clean.
